claim: Both ESO census generators set GENERATED_DIR_REL to "temper/build-deploy-checks", and name-series joins that with the page slug and nothing else. The pages they write are one folder deeper, under temper/build-deploy-checks/modules/, where commit c880396db10 nested every module page on 2026-09-12. So a regeneration renders paths nothing reads: it would stage a second copy of the census beside the one in use rather than over it. That same stale join is how runSlugsThere finds a run already there, so it finds none, goneRels is always empty, and a census that shrinks leaves its dropped run pages behind. Read-verified only, because neither generator was run.

evidence:
The join. `renderSeries` builds every path from `folderRel` at `code/module/modules/name-series/name-series.module.code.ts:110-112`, which is `join(spec.generatedDirRel, slug)` and nothing else. `pageRelOf` at :114-116 and `codeRelOf` at :118-120 append the file name to that folder. No `modules` segment is added anywhere in the module.

The two callers. `command/pages/temper/eso/generate/base-game-global/temper-eso-generate-base-game-global.command.code.ts:44` sets `GENERATED_DIR_REL = "temper/build-deploy-checks"` and hands it to the spec at :135. `command/pages/temper/eso/generate/colon-method/temper-eso-generate-colon-method.command.code.ts:40` sets the same constant and hands it over at :127. So the aggregate of the string-id census renders to `temper/build-deploy-checks/eso-base-game-string-ids/eso-base-game-string-ids.module.code.ts`.

Where the files are. `temper/build-deploy-checks/modules/eso-base-game-string-ids/eso-base-game-string-ids.module.code.ts`, with the 38 runs beside it under that same `modules/` folder, and the domain page naming all 39 at `temper/build-deploy-checks/temper-build-deploy-checks.domain.ts:34-72`. Commit `c880396db10`, `nest module pages under a modules folder`, dated 2026-09-12, moved them there; its stat shows the `{ => modules}` rename running across the whole tree. Neither generator was updated with them.

What follows from the first half. `holdsBody` at :264-268 resolves the rendered path and finds nothing at it, so `stageSeries` at :344-356 chooses by `existsSync` on that same absent path and writes `add-file` rather than `change-file` for every run and for the aggregate. Landing that script would leave two copies of the census, one at each depth, with only the older one imported by `check-addon-sandbox-load`.

The second half is `runSlugsThere` at :239-249. It walks the module index and keeps a slug only where `one.path === pageRelOf(spec, said.slug)`. The index carries the real path, under `modules/`; `pageRelOf` answers the stale one. The two never agree, so `found` comes back empty, so `goneRels` at :330-332 is always empty. A census that shrinks from 38 runs to fewer would leave the surplus run pages behind, with nothing importing them and nothing reporting them gone.

Not verified by running. `bun run` inside the checkout is refused for this agent, so neither generator was executed and no staged tree was inspected. Everything above is read from the four files named. The ~/esoui clone both generators read is also absent from this machine, so a run would refuse at `esouiSourceDir()` before it reached the staging either way, which is one reason this has gone unseen.
